about: An Arista C-360 adopted into a folder: one network on VLAN 20 and settings for all three bands. radio2 is the dedicated scan radio airscan owns (airscan '1'), the same band as radio3: Aeolus leaves it alone, with no radio settings and no wifi-iface (0081). Radio resource management is on in the folder, and on this AP its section says scan 'airscan': the serving radios never scan where there is a scan radio (0081), so the daemon listens through that radio (0116). The wireless, system, firewall and dhcp packages are the AP's own; its management is shown as a VLAN-filtering bridge on the uplink eth0.
